name: Assay-specific kinetic and signal comparisons
description: Extract matched assay conditions and numeric estimates, calculate declared ratios or bounds, and expose substrate/partner and readout dependencies without relabeling apparent parameters as direct binding or native flux.

inputs.measurements: identified rates, Km/Kd/IC50, signals and nondetection thresholds
inputs.context: substrates, partner proteins, concentrations, metal/cofactor, assay direction and units

outputs.table: measurement values with censoring, units, conditions and source locations
outputs.comparability: declared matched dimensions and recorded differences; no automatic scientific verdict

capability_operations.invocation_note: Normalized capability contract; the confirmed callable list identifies existing related primitives only, not interchangeable signatures.

capability_operations.operation: Compute a selected ratio, difference, or simple model prediction

inputs.values: source-bound numeric estimates, inequalities and units
inputs.expression: explicit arithmetic or declared one-parameter prediction

outputs.derived_result: value or lower/upper bound with expression

capability_operations.invocation_note: Normalized capability contract; the confirmed callable list identifies existing related primitives only, not interchangeable signatures.

capability_operations.operation: Fit supplied time-course or saturation data

inputs.points: actual raw/processed values, replicates and units
inputs.model: declared rate equation/error model and fitting settings

outputs.fit: estimates, residuals and uncertainty under that model

capability_operations.invocation_note: Normalized capability contract; the confirmed callable list identifies existing related primitives only, not interchangeable signatures.

repository_catalog_defined: Existing source readers expose input tables. No general registered kinetic-fitting or assay-comparison callable confirmed.
research_operations_performed: comparison/counterexample_calculations.json: selected deaminase censoring bounds and HisN source-table rank comparisons.
specificity/detailed_traces.json: selected YihU mutant apparent-efficiency arithmetic.
root/regulatory_specificity/raw/iscr_comparison_probe.json: published oligo/affinity/competition arithmetic; no raw-curve refit.
capability_specifications_not_confirmed_: New curve fitting requires actual points and an explicit implementation. A Kd/Km/IC50 table does not supply raw observations or statistical support.
author_experiments_are_source_evidence_o: Substrate screening, binding assays, reconstitution, inhibition and kinetic measurement are author-only experiments here.
availability.binding_limit: A repository catalog definition is confirmed source-code identity, not proof of caller enablement, service availability, installed dependencies or execution in this research. Research scripts are retained operations, not registered runtime tools.

limits: Km is not a bindingKd; competitionIC50 is not automaticallyKd.
Censored undetected activity is a bound at the actual assay conditions, not zero.
Coupled-readout specificity can belong to the partner/reporter; noncognate substrate conditions and fixed cosubstrate saturation matter.
